cards.ex: Her body language exuded confidence, even though she was nervous inside.
cards.exUz: Uning tana tili ichida hayajonda bo'lsa ham, ishonch taratardi.
cards.uzDef: O'zini ishonchli tutish, ishonch bilan harakat qilish va shunday ko'rinish.

cards.ex: His sweaty palms were a telltale sign that he was lying.
cards.exUz: Uning terlagan kaftlari yolg'on gapirayotganining bildiruvchi alomati edi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir yashirilganini yoki haqiqatni ko'rsatuvchi aniq belgi.

cards.ex: She met his apology with stony silence, refusing to forgive him.
cards.exUz: U uning uzrini sovuq sukut bilan kutib oldi va uni kechirishdan bosh tortdi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq davom etgan, norozilik yoki g'azabni ifodalovchi sukut.

cards.ex: He had an involuntary twitch in his left eye whenever he was stressed.
cards.exUz: U har safar stressga tushganida chap ko'zida ixtiyorsiz tortishish bo'lardi.
cards.uzDef: Asab yoki hayajon tufayli kelib chiqqan, nazorat qilib bo'lmaydigan kichik harakat.

cards.ex: He gave a sheepish grin when he realized he'd forgotten her birthday.
cards.exUz: U uning tug'ilgan kunini unutganini anglagach, uyatchan tabassum qildi.
cards.uzDef: Aybdorlik yoki xijolatdan kelib chiqqan, noqulay tabassum.

cards.ex: She gazed intently at the painting, trying to decipher its meaning.
cards.exUz: U rasmning ma'nosini tushunishga harakat qilib, unga diqqat bilan tikildi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga juda jiddiy va uzoq vaqt davomida qarash.

cards.ex: He cast a furtive glance at his watch, anxious to leave the meeting.
cards.exUz: U uchrashuvni tark etishga shoshilib, soatiga o'g'rincha bir nazar tashladi.
cards.uzDef: Hech kim sezmasligi uchun tez va yashirincha qarash.

cards.ex: She gave him a dismissive wave and turned her back.
cards.exUz: U unga rad etuvchi ishora qildi va orqasiga o'girildi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani ahamiyatsiz deb hisoblab, e'tiborsiz qoldirishni ko'rsatuvchi qo'l harakati.

cards.ex: His clenched jaw betrayed his anger, even though he remained silent.
cards.exUz: Uning qisilgan jag'i, garchi u sukut saqlagan bo'lsa ham, g'azabini oshkor qildi.
cards.uzDef: G'azab yoki stressdan jag' mushaklarining qattiq taranglashishi.

cards.ex: She wore a pained expression as she listened to his excuses.
cards.exUz: U uning bahonalarini tinglar ekan, azob chekayotgan ifoda bilan o'tirdi.
cards.uzDef: Azob, qayg'u yoki noqulaylikni ko'rsatuvchi yuz ifodasi.

cards.ex: The interviewer noticed the candidate mirroring his behavior, a sign of rapport.
cards.exUz: Intervyu oluvchi nomzodning o'z xatti-harakatini aks ettirayotganini payqadi, bu o'zaro munosabat belgisi edi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa odamning xatti-harakatlarini, pozalarini ongsiz ravishda takrorlash.

cards.ex: The company frowned upon employees using their phones during meetings.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya xodimlarining uchrashuvlar paytida telefonlaridan foydalanishiga norozilik bildiradi.
cards.uzDef: Nimagadir rozi emaslikni yoki ma'qullamaslikni ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: The models struck a pose for the cameras, showcasing the latest fashion trends.
cards.exUz: Modellar kameralar uchun pozaga kirib, so'nggi moda tendentsiyalarini namoyish etishdi.
cards.uzDef: Fotosuratga tushish uchun aniq va maqsadli holatga kelish.

cards.ex: He gesticulated wildly as he recounted his adventurous travels.
cards.exUz: U sarguzashtli sayohatlari haqida gapirib berar ekan, ishtiyoq bilan imo-ishora qildi.
cards.uzDef: Gapirganda qo'llar va qo'llar bilan katta va hayajonli harakatlar qilish.

cards.ex: He gave her a patronizing pat on the head, which she found offensive.
cards.exUz: U unga homiylik bilan boshini siladi, bu unga xafa qiluvchi tuyuldi.
cards.uzDef: Yuqoridan qarash va kam baholashni ifodalovchi yengil silash.

cards.ex: His shifty eyes made me suspicious of his intentions.
cards.exUz: Uning bezovta nigohlari meni uning niyatlariga shubha qilishga majbur qildi.
cards.uzDef: Nervozlik, yolg'on yoki yashirin narsani ko'rsatadigan nigohlar.

cards.ex: The politician gave a lingering handshake, trying to connect with voters.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchi saylovchilar bilan aloqa o'rnatishga harakat qilib, cho'zilgan qo'l berishish qildi.
cards.uzDef: Odatdagidan ko'ra uzoqroq davom etadigan, yaqinlikni yoki manipulyatsiyani anglatishi mumkin bo'lgan qo'l berishish.

cards.ex: She responded to his suggestion with a dismissive snort.
cards.exUz: U uning taklifiga rad etuvchi xurrak bilan javob berdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani mensimaslik yoki masxara qilishni ifodalovchi ovoz chiqarish.

cards.ex: He adopted a defensive posture, crossing his arms and leaning back.
cards.exUz: U himoyaviy pozitsiyani qabul qildi, qo'llarini bog'ladi va orqaga suyanib oldi.
cards.uzDef: Jismoniy holatni, odatda ma'lum bir hissiyotni yoki niyatni ifodalash uchun qabul qilish.

cards.ex: The room transmitted peaceful vibes with its soft lighting and calming music.
cards.exUz: Xona yumshoq yoritish va tinchlantiruvchi musiqa bilan tinchlik energiyasini tarqatardi.
cards.uzDef: Atrofga ma'lum bir hissiyot yoki atmosfera tarqatish.

cards.ex: She held herself aloof, rarely interacting with her colleagues.
cards.exUz: U o'zini chetda tutdi, hamkasblari bilan kamdan-kam muloqot qildi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalar bilan do'stona yoki yaqin munosabatda bo'lmaslik.

cards.ex: A fleeting smile crossed her face as she remembered the happy memory.
cards.exUz: Baxtli xotirani eslar ekan, uning yuzida tez o'tadigan tabassum paydo bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Tez va qisqa muddatli tabassum.

cards.ex: He greeted them with a disarming smile, putting them at ease.
cards.exUz: U ularni ishonchni qozonuvchi tabassum bilan kutib oldi va ularni xotirjam qildi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarni xavotir yoki g'azabdan xalos qiladigan tabassum.

cards.ex: She signaled her agreement with a subtle nod of her head.
cards.exUz: U boshini yengil egib, roziligini bildirdi.
cards.uzDef: Tananing harakatlari yoki ifodalari orqali kelishuvni ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: Paying attention to nonverbal cues can help you understand what someone is really thinking.
cards.exUz: Og'zaki bo'lmagan signallarga e'tibor berish sizga kimdir aslida nimani o'ylayotganini tushunishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: So'zlar bilan emas, balki tana tili, yuz ifodalari va ohang orqali uzatiladigan ma'lumot.

cards.ex: She sized up the new employee before deciding whether to trust him.
cards.exUz: U unga ishonishga qaror qilishdan oldin yangi xodimni baholashga urindi.
cards.uzDef: Kimgadir yoki nimagadir diqqat bilan qarab, ular haqida fikr bildirish.

cards.ex: He gave me the eye when the boss started asking difficult questions.
cards.exUz: Boshliq qiyin savollar bera boshlaganda, u menga ko'z bilan ishora qildi.
cards.uzDef: Odatda ogohlantirish yoki yashirin ma'lumot uzatish uchun ko'z bilan signal berish.

cards.ex: He had a nervous tic of clearing his throat before speaking.
cards.exUz: U gapirishdan oldin asabiy ravishda tomoq qirardi.
cards.uzDef: Stress yoki hayajon tufayli sodir bo'ladigan takroriy, ixtiyorsiz harakat.

cards.ex: The protesters adopted a defiant stance, refusing to move from the street.
cards.exUz: Namoyishchilar ko'chadan ketishdan bosh tortib, itaatsizlik pozitsiyasini qabul qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Norozilik yoki qarshilikni ifodalovchi holat.

cards.ex: She adopted an open posture, signaling that she was receptive to new ideas.
cards.exUz: U yangi g'oyalarni qabul qilishga tayyorligini bildirib, ochiq pozitsiyani qabul qildi.
cards.uzDef: Ochiqlik, do'stlik va ishonchni ko'rsatadigan tananing holati.
